This well-established Australian business operates within the precious metals industry, providing bullion, trading and investment services to both private and corporate clients.

  • Assist with compliance testing, audits and remediation activities
  • Support regulatory changes and updates to policies, procedures and AML/CTF programs
  • Assist with compliance reporting, training and broader risk initiatives
  • Support third-party due diligence and insurance administration  
You
  
To be successful in this role, you will bring:  
  • Previous experience within AML/CTF, financial crime, risk, compliance or a related regulatory function
  • A strong understanding of KYC/CDD, ECDD, transaction monitoring and AUSTRAC obligations
  • Well-developed analytical and investigative skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Exposure to an AFSL-regulated environment, audits, compliance reviews or policy development will be advantageous  
You will be a proactive and commercially minded compliance professional who enjoys investigating issues, solving problems and working with the broader business to achieve practical and compliant outcomes.

job.title: Mortgage Collections Officer
job.description:
The Company
Our client is a highly regarded specialist lender with an established presence across Australia and New Zealand. Known for their flexible home loan solutions and customer first philosophy, they support customers whose financial circumstances may fall outside traditional lending models.

With a strong reputation in the market, the organisation offers a collaborative and supportive culture where integrity, teamwork and service excellence are highly valued. Their leadership team is approachable, experienced and committed to delivering positive outcomes for both customers and employees.

The Opportunity
A permanent opportunity has become available based in the Sydney CBD offices, with immediate start available (4 weeks notice is fine too).

Reporting to the Collections Manager, you will support the wider collections team by managing a portfolio of consumer mortgage accounts up to 30 days in arrears.

This role requires a balanced approach — achieving strong recovery outcomes while maintaining empathy and professionalism when working with customers.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Contacting customers to discuss overdue accounts and recover outstanding arrears in a professional and respectful manner
  • Negotiating and implementing realistic repayment arrangements tailored to each customer’s situation
  • Monitoring repayment plans and following up on commitments
  • Liaising with internal stakeholders including Customer Service, Credit and Legal teams to resolve matters efficiently
  • Maintaining accurate records and ensuring compliance with internal processes and regulatory requirements
  • Achieving individual KPIs while contributing to a collaborative, high-performing team environment
This opportunity would suit someone who enjoys structured targets, meaningful customer interaction and working within a supportive financial services team.

About You
To be successful in this opportunity, you will bring the following experience and qualities:
  • Minimum 18 months’ collections experience within financial services OR 18 months customer service experience within a financial services environment
  • Confidence managing sensitive conversations regarding overdue accounts
  • Strong negotiation and influencing skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and organisational ability
  • A proactive mindset and the ability to quickly integrate into an established team
  • Comfortable handling 60-80 outbound calls daily 
  • Availability to commence immediately or at short notice will be highly regarded
How to Apply 
If you bring a genuine empathy for others, can adapt to changing environments, and looking for a long term permanent role with a well regarded financial services organisation, we encourage you to apply. Email your résumé to jquigley@sbrecruitment.com or call Jenny on 02 9002 5005 for a confidential conversation.
 
SB Recruitment takes the security of our candidates seriously. We will never request your bank details or contact you via WhatsApp or Telegram during the hiring process. Please notify us immediately if you receive any suspicious communication.

job.description:
The Company
Our client is a local council delivering community programs that support participation, connection and wellbeing across the local government area.
The Youth Team works with young people aged 12–25, delivering inclusive cultural, educational, social and recreational programs in partnership with schools, community organisations and other stakeholders.

They are seeking casual Youth & Community Workers to join their pool and provide additional support across existing programs. This is a multi-site role, with programs delivered across locations including Millers Point, Moore Park, Rosebery and other community venues.

  • Assist with activity supervision, set-up and pack-down.
  • Follow safety procedures, risk assessments and safeguarding requirements.
  • Support administration, referrals and support pathways.
  • Identify and escalate concerns or disclosures appropriately.

You
To be successful, you will have:

  • Strong communication, interpersonal and rapport-building skills.

How to Apply
If you're a Youth & Community Worker looking for flexible casual work where you can make a genuine difference in the community, we'd love to hear from you.

Please apply via the company job board.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
